section: Nataka Samasthalu - theatre companies and their nationalist role
subsections: Padya natakam vs social drama - features

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Padya natakam and social drama:
1. Padya natakam generally deals with mythological or epic themes.
2. Social drama addresses contemporary social evils such as bride-price, dowry and widowhood.
3. Padya natakam is generally presented in prose using spoken Telugu.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1, 2 and 3
1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
accepted.x: Padya natakam deals mainly with mythological or epic themes, whereas social drama focuses on contemporary social evils. Padya natakam uses sung verse rather than prose in spoken Telugu.
accepted.tq: Split the statements by comparing the subject matter and language of the two dramatic forms.
accepted.sec: Padya natakam vs social drama - features

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Social drama — Exclusive treatment of epic legends
Padya natakam — Prose in spoken Telugu
Social drama — Sung verse or padyam
Padya natakam — Mythological or epic content
accepted.x: Padya natakam is associated with mythological or epic content. Social drama is generally written in prose using spoken Telugu and deals with contemporary social issues.
accepted.tq: Use the content-language distinction to identify the correctly matched feature.
accepted.sec: Padya natakam vs social drama - features

accepted.s:
With reference to Telugu dramatic literature, consider the following pairs:

List-I (Work or repertoire)
 a. Surabhi repertoire
 b. Gayopakhyanam
 c. Kanyasulkam
 d. Varavikrayam

List-II (Dramatic category)
 i. Social drama
 ii. Padya natakam

Which of the following is the correct classification?
o: a–ii, b–ii, c–i, d–i
a–i, b–ii, c–i, d–ii
a–ii, b–i, c–ii, d–i
a–i, b–i, c–ii, d–ii
accepted.x: Surabhi repertoire and Gayopakhyanam are associated with Padya natakam. Kanyasulkam and Varavikrayam are examples of social drama.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair: Kanyasulkam is a social drama, then eliminate codes containing a wrong classification.
accepted.sec: Padya natakam vs social drama - features

accepted.s: Which of the following statements best describes the contribution of Gurajada to Telugu dramatic writing?
o: He restricted social drama to mythological themes and epic narratives.
He replaced live theatre with Tholu Bommalata puppetry.
He made spoken Telugu the norm for writing, thereby widening the audience.
He made sung verse the compulsory medium of all Telugu dramas.
accepted.x: Gurajada made spoken Telugu the norm for writing. This widened the audience for Telugu dramatic literature.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise contribution rather than choosing an option that reverses the language and audience relationship.
accepted.sec: Padya natakam vs social drama - features

accepted.s: Drama companies in the nineteenth and early twentieth-century social setting became effective vehicles for reform and nationalist messages mainly because they were
o: restricted to court performances for rulers and officials
limited to performances of religious rituals
the main form of mass entertainment of the time
conducted exclusively through written pamphlets
accepted.x: Drama companies were the main mass entertainment of the time. Their wide reach enabled them to communicate reformist and nationalist messages to the public.
accepted.tq: Link the social reach of an institution with its effectiveness as a vehicle for public messages.

accepted.s: Nataka Vidyalayam, which trained students in the dramatic arts, was started at which place and on which date?
o: Visakhapatnam, 1 August 1964
Vijayawada, 1 August 1964
Vijayawada, 15 August 1947
Guntur, 26 January 1950
accepted.x: Nataka Vidyalayam was started at Vijayawada on 1 August 1964 and trained students in the dramatic arts.
accepted.tq: Combine the location and date, avoiding distractors formed by swapping the place or date.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about Surabhi is correct?
o: Surabhi is a social drama written in prose by Gurajada.
Surabhi was a training institution established at Vijayawada in 1964.
Surabhi refers exclusively to Tholu Bommalata puppetry.
Surabhi is a family theatre tradition that still survives.
accepted.x: Surabhi continues as a family theatre tradition. It is distinct from Nataka Vidyalayam and is associated with live Telugu theatre.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the surviving theatre tradition from the training institution and the earlier puppetry form.

accepted.s: Surabhi is regarded as marking which transition in the history of Telugu theatre?
o: From social drama to epic poetry
From sung verse to spoken prose only
From Tholu Bommalata puppets to live Telugu family theatre
From nationalist theatre to court-sponsored performances
accepted.x: Surabhi marks the shift from Tholu Bommalata puppets to live Telugu family theatre. This transition is central to its significance in Telugu theatrical culture.
accepted.tq: Identify the first-to-last transition by matching the earlier puppetry form with the later live family theatre form.
